external_target_opening_rule: Complete target-bearing files and archive members may be opened only after this specification and a complete value-free source-record identity registry are byte-sealed.

required_topology.catalyst_identity_return: The same single-molecule palladium catalyst identity is present at cycle entry and after reductive elimination.
required_topology.complete_cycle_trace: Every sequential electrical state attributed to oxidative addition or ligand exchange, pretransmetallation, transmetallation and reductive elimination remains in the periodic cycle word.
required_topology.complete_turnover_surface: Every accessible source-data file, trace, cycle, duration, condition, control, adverse and unresolved record remains registered without selecting a favorable turnover.

selection_basis_before_target_opening: The primary study was selected because its public abstract and source topology disclose a periodic single-molecule catalytic cycle, explicit sequential intermediate signals, catalyst return, overall catalytic timescale, complete supplementary material, source-data archives and an open Zenodo dataset. No numerical turnover, cycle-duration, intermediate-lifetime, frequency, fitted rate or source-data value selected the source or law.
